decision: Rejected: native paged microbenchmark gains did not translate to Windows startup; most paged interpreter cases regressed. Production code restored.

win95.scope: Five alternating headless rtts Win95 startup prefixes, stop at 300M instructions, host network disconnected, no frame capture or UI control. Guest/device fields and total instruction count match; implementation JIT counters, disk path and host timing may differ; not bytewise RAM equality or Explorer readiness/timing.

earlyProbe.note: Both guests completed, then strict implementation-counter equality failed. Process timings were not preserved. Guest/device state agrees excluding implementation counters.
